title: Product-address vocabulary with collision-resolving Mirror codes
hypothesis: When a multiplicative quotient/remainder address maps two token IDs to each shared-table pair, one token-specific Givens angle can restore distinct logical embedding functions with lower complete payload than native two-coefficient product/hash embeddings and far below a full table.
physical_object: Two fixed shared 32x16 component tables. A deterministic Cartesian product address space contains 1,024 pairs for 2,048 token IDs, so every address pair has exactly two token occupants.
mirror_coordinate: One token-specific angle forms cos(theta_i)Q[a_i]+sin(theta_i)R[b_i], providing a compact continuous view that can separate tokens sharing the same product address.
logical_multiplicity: 2,048 token embeddings from 1,024 discrete product addresses plus one Mirror angle per token; each product address has two logical occupants.
prior_art_delta: PA43 product keys create multiplicative discrete address spaces; PA58 adds token importance coefficients over shared hash components; PA59 uses complementary partitions. This experiment fixes a collision-heavy Cartesian address and tests whether one continuous Mirror coordinate resolves its two logical occupants more compactly than native two-coefficient importance values.

model.address_rule: a_i=i mod 32; b_i=floor(i/32) mod 32; token i and i+1024 share a pair
methods: product-address plus two unrestricted per-token importance coefficients
product-address plus one per-token Givens Mirror angle

teacher.tables: Two fixed seeded random 32x16 component tables; all component values are paid in compositional payloads.
teacher.embedding: Each token receives a seeded angle and teacher vector cos(theta_i)Q[a_i]+sin(theta_i)R[b_i]. Colliding token pairs receive independent angles.
teacher.task_quality: One fixed seeded 16x16 decoder generates token classes. Report embedding NRMSE, decoder NLL/top-1, and collision-pair separation NRMSE comparing predicted versus teacher vector differences for i and i+1024.
teacher.collision_audit: Verify 1,024 unique product addresses, exactly two occupants per address, and zero unique-address tokens.

controls: native unrestricted two-coefficient importance vector per token

development.selection_metric: Embedding NRMSE and collision-pair separation NRMSE are primary; decoder NLL/top-1, complete bytes, compute and runtime are secondary.
development.allowed_tuning: No tuning planned. Addresses, tables, teacher, schedule and optimizer are fixed. Correctness-only fixes can rerun development before fresh access.

fresh.open_gate: Both development worlds: full and direct-coefficient NRMSE <=0.03; Mirror NRMSE <=0.03 and decoder NLL within .02 nat/top-1 within 1pp of direct coefficients; Mirror collision-pair separation NRMSE <=0.03; Mirror complete payload <=0.25x full table and <=0.80x direct coefficients; Mirror beats pure addition by >=0.05 embedding NRMSE and >=0.20 pair-separation NRMSE; address occupancy audit and exact payload replay pass. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
fresh.fresh_success: All three fresh worlds satisfy quality, collision separation, actual-byte, occupancy and replay gates.

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: full embedding table or both shared 32x16 component tables
every per-token direct coefficient pair or Mirror angle
address dimensions/rule metadata and archive overhead
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Product addresses are exact arithmetic functions of token ID and dimensions; no index list is stored.

success_gate: All fresh worlds satisfy complete-payload, fidelity, collision-separation, native-coefficient and exact-replay criteria.
failure_gate: Any development fidelity, collision distinction, bytes or replay gate fails.
boundaries: deliberately collision-heavy synthetic product-address vocabulary; not a recommender or language-model result
teacher is aligned to the Mirror unit-circle orbit
all tokens collide by construction; no natural address-frequency distribution is tested
fixed updates do not establish near-convergence or capacity
